过.es: haber hecho alguna vez; partícula de experiencia
过.en: have ever done; particle of experience
过.consejo: It goes after the verb and does not have the tone of the verb.

旅游.consejo: You can describe a travel activity.

出国.es: ir al extranjero; salir del país
出国.consejo: It's used for a trip out of the country itself.

过年.en: to celebrate the Chinese New Year
过年.consejo: It may also refer to the New Year period.

酒店.consejo: It's a place where a person stays.

饭.consejo: It may refer to food or cooked rice.

回来.consejo: The address is coming to the place you're talking about.

回去.consejo: The address is away from the place you're talking about.

去 过.es: haber ido alguna vez; haber visitado
去 过.consejo: It is «go» and it is an experience.

看 过.consejo: The experience is about seeing something.

吃 过.consejo: The experience is about eating something.

坐 过 飞机.es: haber viajado alguna vez en avión
坐 过 飞机.consejo: In this case, it is a travel experience.

什么时候.consejo: He asked for the time for an action.

texto: **过** after the verb indicates that someone has ever lived or done something: **去过中国** = having been in China. It doesn't say when it happened.
**了** usually presents a action as done or a concrete change; **过** speaks of the accumulated experience. The tone of the particle **过** is neutral, different from the verb **过** («cruzar»).

frases.zh: 你 去 过 中国 吗？
frases.es: Li Hua: ¿Has estado alguna vez en China?
frases.en: Li Hua: Have you ever been to China?
analisis: 去 过 中国 吗
Have you ever been to China?

frases.zh: 去 过。我 去 中国 旅游 过。
frases.es: Anna: Sí. He viajado a China.
frases.en: Anna: Yes. I've traveled to China.
analisis: 去 中国 旅游 过

frases.zh: 你 去 年 出国 了 吗？
frases.es: Li Hua: ¿Fuiste al extranjero el año pasado?
frases.en: Li Hua: Did you go abroad last year?

frases.zh: 去 年 过年，我 和 家人 出国 旅游。
frases.es: Anna: El año pasado, durante el Año Nuevo, viajé al extranjero con mi familia.
frases.en: Anna: Last year, during the New Year, I traveled abroad with my family.
analisis: during the New Year of last year

frases.zh: 你 坐 飞机 去 吗？
frases.en: Li Hua: Are you on a plane?
analisis: 坐 飞机 去 吗

frases.zh: 坐 过。我 也 在 酒店 吃 过 饭。
frases.es: Anna: Sí, he viajado en avión. También he comido en un hotel.
frases.en: Anna: Yes, I've been on a plane. I also ate in a hotel.
analisis: 在 酒店 吃 过 饭

frases.zh: 你 什么时候 回来？
frases.en: Li Hua: When are you coming back?

frases.zh: 我 昨天 回来 了。
我 去 过 中国。
我 去 年 过年 出国 旅游。
frases.es: El año pasado viajé al extranjero durante el Año Nuevo chino.
frases.en: Last year I traveled abroad during Chinese New Year.
analisis: during the New Year of last year

frases.zh: 我 坐 过 飞机。
frases.es: He viajado en avión alguna vez.
frases.en: I've been on a plane ever.

frases.zh: 我 在 酒店 住 过。
frases.es: Me he alojado en un hotel alguna vez.
frases.en: I've stayed in a hotel once.

frases.zh: 我 昨天 回来 了。
你 什么时候 回去？
frases.en: When are you going back there?

bloques.pregunta: What does it indicate after a verb?

opciones.texto: That someone has ever lived that experience.
opciones.explicacion: You don't have to say when it happened.

opciones.texto: That the action is happening right now.
That the action still doesn't start.

bloques.frase: 你 去 过 中国 吗？

opciones.texto: Have you ever been to China?
Are you going to China now?
When do you come back from China?

opciones.explicacion: It indicates that I have already had that experience.
It's the ticket, it's not going here.
It's the place where you stay.

bloques.audio: 你 什么时候 回来？

opciones.texto: Where are you going by plane?

bloques.frase: 我 住 在 酒店
bloques.explicacion: The place is indicated by «stay» and the place is indicated.

bloques.frase: 我 昨天 回来 了。

opciones.explicacion: To leave the country is to be seen.

intro: You will have previous trips and experiences. Look at the difference between an experience and a finished action.
